paragraphs: Growth, collaboration and connected workflows can outgrow the current accounting setup. A move should solve an operating problem, not simply replace software.
Ask: What will your team be able to do afterward?
topics.title: Why businesses migrate

paragraphs: Accounts, customers, suppliers, products and transactions are only part of the picture. History, tax, settings, access and integrations need explicit scope too. Unsupported items must be visible, never silently dropped.
Ask: What is included, excluded or blocked?
topics.title: What gets migrated

paragraphs: A mapping connects a source concept to its intended destination. Similar names do not guarantee the same accounting meaning. Review evidence and compatible alternatives before approving.
Ask: Does this destination preserve the meaning of the source?
topics.title: Why mappings matter

paragraphs: Moving a record is not proof that it moved correctly. Rules compare counts, references and balances against source evidence. A mismatch blocks progress; approval cannot turn a failed check into a pass.
Ask: Which check passed, and which evidence supports it?
topics.title: What reconciliation means

paragraphs: Decisions affecting accounting treatment, access or business operations need an accountable person. You may approve, reject or stop. An agent cannot approve its own consequential proposal.
Ask: What changes, what is the risk, and can it be reversed?
topics.title: Why some decisions require approval

paragraphs: Confidence expresses uncertainty in a recommendation. It is not a guarantee or permission to act. The current Beta uses versioned policy-based suggestions, not a live model's calibrated predictions.
Ask: What uncertainty remains, even if confidence looks high?
topics.title: What confidence means

paragraphs: Evidence connects a finding to source facts, a rule result or an attributable decision. Explanations help you understand the evidence; they cannot replace it.
Ask: Can I trace this recommendation to a fact or check?
topics.title: What evidence means

paragraphs: The same inputs and versioned rules must produce the same accounting result. Models may explain or suggest; exact calculations, reconciliation and approval controls decide whether work can proceed.
Ask: Is this a suggestion or a verified result?
topics.title: Why financial truth is deterministic

paragraphs: Work pauses at a safe boundary, preserving completed checkpoints and failure evidence. Review the proposed remedy. Consequential recovery needs your approval; retry only when the workflow permits it.
Ask: What completed, what failed, and what will retry do?
topics.title: What happens when migration fails

paragraphs: Required data, setup, access and onboarding checks pass, then an authorized user completes an agreed task with verified evidence. In this Beta that is a synthetic invoice—not proof of production readiness.
Ask: Has the productive task been verified, not merely posted?
topics.title: What Business ready · verified means
